If I want to continue my journey through the world of the arcane, I will need to choose a faction. Only they can provide the knowledge I seek.

This is given to me as a choice of a series of tasks to complete. I must choose wisely. 
My faction, once chosen, cannot be changed.

Once I choose a faction, I will make enemies out of the other ones. Their troops, which can be found throughout the various worlds will become hostile to me.

However, I do not stand alone. My own faction's mobs will come to my aid if they see me in trouble.

My faction gives me access to unique relics and spell parts, and each faction gains special abilities from certain enchantments placed on spell focus items such as staves, bangles, or wands.

The occulus shows these items by putting a badge representing the appropriate faction on the item's card. 

I cannot craft the spells and artifacts from the other factions, however I can trade for them either by doing the Ritual of the Iron Bell, or by simply trading with other wizards in a collaborative environment.

Though I must take care: using spells and relics from the other factions will eventually cause them to raid me, which involves them sending very powerful assassins after me. 

These assassins have more devastating abilities than their commonly found counterparts, and will prove significantly tougher to defeat.
